verdict.rationale: A month-end close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs is a fair axis for small-business accounting software, so it applies to Wave. The evidence pack documents no close checklist, close workflow, or sign-off tracking. Bank feeds, comparative reports, and accountant user roles are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
